newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Feb retail sales down 4.21 percent.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Feb retail sales down 4.21 percent.

text.p: Colombia's retail sales, excluding fuel, fell 4.21 percent in February compared with the same month in 1996, the National Statistics Department said in a statement Thursday.
The retail sales figure excluding vehicle and fuel sales was 3.2 percent lower than in February last year.

But the statistics department said the figure, based on sales in Colombia's 12 largest cities, was up 1.45 percent, excluding fuel, for the first two months of this year compared to the same period in 1996.
Sales, excluding vehicles and fuel, were up 2.04 percent in January and February compared to last year.
February's retail sales figures were dragged down by drops in the sales of fuel, vehicles, spare parts and iron goods, according to the statistics department.
Pharmaceutical product sales are showing healthy gains and clothing and footwear are picking up, the government department said.
